how_to_use: Each entry maps an existing citation (file, JSON path or line, old URL) to replacement source(s). status: 'replace' = verified authoritative source supports the same claim; 'replace_with_correction' = authoritative source supports a corrected value (see 'correction'); 'partial' = better source found for part of the claim; 'no_replacement' = keep old as secondary and flag. Numbers are not changed by this file except where 'correction' says so.

mappings.claim: Rosoboronexport 2014 revenue RUB 22.04bn, net profit RUB 9.67bn

new.what: Rosoboronexport's filed RAS statements (data from FNS and Rosstat databases): 2014 EBIT RUB 10,354,546k; return on sales 58.2%
FNS-based register: 2014 net profit RUB 9,667,235k

mappings.correction: Net profit 9.67bn is confirmed by FNS-based data. Revenue 22.04bn is not: EBIT / return on sales implies about RUB 17.8bn. With ROE's own 2014 deliveries of USD 13.2bn (about RUB 0.5trn), the commission is 3.5-4.4% and net profit about 1.9% of contract value, so the +0.02 (0.01-0.03) arms margin term is unchanged.

new.what: Kremlin, meeting of the Commission for Military-Technical Cooperation, 27 Jan 2015: 'The total volume of sales exceeded $15 billion. We signed almost $14 billion worth of contracts'

mappings.correction: USD 13bn was a December 2014 preliminary figure from a Kremlin aide. The official full-year 2014 figure is >USD 15bn for all exporters. Rosoboronexport's own deliveries were USD 13.2bn (its 2014 annual report, as quoted by Profile.ru), and that is the right denominator for its commission. The note should say 'USD 13.2bn (Rosoboronexport), >15bn (all exporters, Kremlin)'.
